🌪️ Tropical Depression Two (Basyang)

A tropical depression is strengthening over the Philippine Sea and moving west toward the Philippines. Impacts are expected from Thursday, mainly across the southern and central regions.

📍 Current status (Wed, 4 Feb | 14:00 PHT)
• ~1,440 km ESE of Manila
• Winds 56 km/h (gusts 74 km/h)
• Moving west at 13 km/h

⚠️ What to expect
• Heavy rain from Thursday morning, especially over Mindanao
• Peak winds up to 90 km/h possible before landfall
• Local rainfall 50–150 mm, isolated 200+ mm (flooding & landslides)
• Rough seas with waves up to 5 m near northeastern Mindanao
• Track continues toward Palawan and the South China Sea by Saturday

👉 Monitor updates and follow local authorities.
